o_side_observation_note: Current O main contains its own read-only open-source research checkpoint at note/research_workers_clean_g1/open_source/CHECKPOINT.json. It was treated only as evidence of what O currently knows, never as clean candidate input.

assessments.mechanism: Preserve historical-best checkpoints independently of exploratory continuation; final/deployment selection need not equal the last attempt.
assessments.clean_scope: RSIBench-Data trajectories show later regression across 24 settings; descriptive/non-monotone evidence, not a universal causal law.
assessments.uncertainty: Longitudinal historical-best preservation is not isolated as a direct O experiment.
assessments.o_comparison: O has immutable histories, reversible Candidate states and one bounded checkpoint-inheritance experiment. That exact experiment tested width-1 versus width-3 sibling checkpoints on three frozen tasks and rejected only that configuration because invocations rose 1.0→3.0 while median wall time improved 0.827209s. It did not test RSIBench-style longitudinal historical-best preservation and is not evidence against the broader family.

assessments.mechanism: Distill reusable procedural skills from heterogeneous multi-model traces rather than one model's experience.
assessments.clean_scope: AFTER enterprise-task transfer evidence; public repository confirms task/evaluation structure but not every experiment table.
assessments.uncertainty: No O matched held-out cross-model trace-pool distillation result.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly seeks heterogeneous methods and persists reusable Episodes/Candidates, so the broad principle is known; it has no multi-model trace-pool procedural distillation or held-out cross-model transfer experiment.

assessments.mechanism: Gate skill/memory injection by model×scaffold×domain compatibility, preserve vanilla/base fallback, and track negative transfer.
assessments.clean_scope: EvoAgentBench cells show large method×scaffold×model interactions. Clean continuation finds public Memento np_memory.py performs unconditional top-k cosine retrieval when memory is nonempty with no minimum-similarity threshold/compatibility classifier/vanilla fallback in that code path. This does not prove it caused EvoAgentBench's -36.3pp SWE-Bench cell because the benchmark's third-party adapter/config is not public.
assessments.uncertainty: Causal adapter details are blocked; do not generalize Memento failure beyond tested cell or infer forced retrieval caused it.
assessments.o_comparison: O Candidates are exact-scope/reversible with active-component fallback and situation-dependent context routing, so gating/fallback submechanisms exist. O has not learned/evaluated a model×scaffold×domain skill router or reproduced EvoAgentBench negative-transfer cells.

assessments.mechanism: Explicit persistent-state consultation/render/route/gate/closeout stages, with retrieval-before-action and authoritative closeout.
assessments.clean_scope: PAST-Bench aggregate gains are noisy and capability interactions strong; mechanism diagnosis is stronger than a universal headline win.
assessments.uncertainty: No O component ablation matching PAST retrieval/gate/closeout stages.
assessments.o_comparison: O Context Kernel already performs authoritative source consultation, typed rendering, optional routing, action binding/recheck and durable receipt/closeout. It has not separately ablated PAST-style retrieval gate/closeout components for task-level persistence gains.
